items.stem: Explain any four benefits of a cash flow statement.
items.answer: (i) Helps in short-term financial planning: Shows expected sources and uses of cash. (ii) Shows the ability to generate cash: Operating cash flows show the strength of the business. (iii) Helps assess liquidity and solvency: Users judge the ability to pay debts. (iv) Explains the difference between profit and cash: Profit and cash position can be reconciled. (v) Helps in comparison over years: Cash flows of different periods can be compared.
items.markingKey: Any four points, 1½ marks each (heading and explanation): (i) Helps in short-term financial planning: Shows expected sources and uses of cash. (ii) Shows the ability to generate cash: Operating cash flows show the strength of the business. (iii) Helps assess liquidity and solvency: Users judge the ability to pay debts. (iv) Explains the difference between profit and cash: Profit and cash position can be reconciled. (v) Helps in comparison over years: Cash flows of different periods can be compared.
